**Volt 1.2.3 — Color-Gradient Battery Percentage**

* Adds clean numerical battery percentage to iOS 12 status bar
* Dynamic color tinting: Green (>40%) > Yellow (20-40%) > Red (<20%)
* Safe Substrate hooks on UIStatusBarBatteryPercentItemView
* Settings bundle in Settings > Volt
* Strict Pure GNU Tar format (resolves corrupted filesystem tarfile error)

**Compatibility:** iPhone 5s (Apple A7 arm64), iOS 12.0 – 12.5.8.
**Architecture:** Rootful Sileo / Zebra / Cydia APT.
